user_story: As a user, I want to be able to view different HTTP status code pages so that I can understand how my application handles different responses. Acceptance Criteria: 1. When I navigate to the URL 'https://the-internet.herokuapp.com/status_codes', I should see the heading 'Status Codes'. 2. Clicking on the link with text '200' should navigate me to the URL 'https://the-internet.herokuapp.com/status_codes/200'. 3. Clicking on the link with text '404' should still allow me to access the status code page but should not display a success message.
